names.rationale: FY26 filings align screen FCF with statutory OCF $1,247M and ~$806M OCF−capex; earnings/dividend strength supports strong buy, while McPhillamys permitting and gold cyclicality cap conviction.
Research confirms the strong-buy case on FY26 OCF $1,247m and NPAT $715m versus screen FCF $806m; gold cyclicality, Q1 AISC above FY27 guidance and McPhillamys redetermination pending remain.

FY26 filings confirm cash generation and liquidity, but screen FCF (~$1.02B) is Yahoo FY26 annual, not verified TTM; lithium price weakness and ~A$1.9B P2000 FID keep cyclical and capex risks live versus a neutral hold.

Research weakens the hold: FY26 cash and a 5cps dividend at ~22% of adjusted FCF are real, but unverified TTM FCF, a silent cyclical overlay and ~A$2.7bn growth spend into weaker lithium prices leave the buy-to-hold gap open.

Filings back branded trading profit, deleveraging and dividends, but FY25/26 statutory OCF (£186.0m) vs management free cash flow (£153.1m; H1 £24.0m) sustains the screen’s FCF overlay—supporting adjusted buy, not unrevised strong buy.
Research weakens the raw strong buy: FY statutory OCF−CapEx dividend cover is 5.54×, but H1 cover is below 1.0×, screen management cover is −1.81×, and adjusted_signal is already buy.
